description:
Generate perpendicular transects along the Danube River for a hydrological survey.

1. Open QGIS.
2. Load the river dataset from '/home/ga/GIS_Data/natural_earth/ne_10m_rivers_lake_centerlines.shp'.
3. Select features representing the 'Danube' river. You may need to check the attribute table (look for 'name' or 'name_en').
4. Create a new layer from the selection or use the Dissolve tool on the selected features to create a single continuous river feature.
5. IMPORTANT: Reproject this river feature to a metric CRS (like EPSG:3857 or EPSG:3035) so you can work in meters.
6. Generate transects along the river using the 'Transects' processing algorithm.
   - Spacing: 20000 meters (20 km)
   - Length: 10000 meters (10 km)
   - Side: Both (or centered)
7. Export the resulting transects as a GeoJSON file to '/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/danube_transects.geojson'.
